info.name: Apifreaks Api Hub For Developers Financial APIs API
Get VAT rate by country code

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

params.name: country
params.description: Country identifier in Alpha-2 (PK), Alpha-3 (PAK), or full name (Pakistan). Combine with the optional "state" query for sub-national VAT; values are case-insensitive and may use underscores instead of spaces.

params.name: state
params.description: Optional state or region in Alpha-2 (NY) or full name (New_York). Use with "country" for state-level VAT; values are case-insensitive and may use underscores.

items.docs: Fetches VAT rates for a single country or state provided via query parameters.

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

items.docs: Retrieves VAT details for multiple countries or country-state combinations in a single request. Maximum of `100` entries per request are allowed.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Default is JSON.

params.name: type
params.description: Accepted by the endpoint but currently has no effect — all three categories (VAT, IBAN, SWIFT) are always returned regardless of this value.

items.docs: Returns the countries and states supported by the VAT, IBAN, and SWIFT APIs.

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

items.docs: Checks an IBAN for structural validity, checksum accuracy, and bank metadata.

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

params.name: country
params.description: Country name (accepts full name, e.g., Pakistan, United States). If supplied alone, returns the list of bank names in that country. If omitted entirely, returns the list of all supported countries.

params.name: bank
params.description: Bank name (upper case) to drill into. Requires country to also be set. If supplied without city, returns the list of cities that bank operates in.

params.name: city
params.description: City (upper case) to narrow results to. Requires country and bank to also be set. Returns the matching SWIFT/BIC codes for that bank in that city.

items.docs: Drills down from countries to banks to cities to SWIFT/BIC codes, one parameter level at a time.

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

params.name: swiftCode
params.description: SWIFT/BIC code to lookup (must be 8 or 11 characters).

items.docs: Fetches detailed information about a SWIFT code.

info.name: Validate EU and UK VAT number

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

params.name: vatNumber
params.description: EU or UK VAT number to validate.

params.name: requesterVatNumber
params.description: Requester EU or UK VAT number.

items.docs: Validates an EU or UK VAT number and returns registration status details.

info.name: Get VAT rate by IP address

params.name: format
params.description: Specify the desired response format. Options: 'json' (default) or 'xml'.

params.name: ipAddress
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up VAT rate for. If omitted, the originating IP address will be used.

items.docs: Fetches VAT rate based on the specified or originating IP address.
